茶城或许还有漏网之鱼，但那暂时已经不在调研一组的工作范围内了。

手头抓到的两条大鱼足够所有人忙活一段时间，至于剩下收尾的工作，秦朗则直接“下放”给了地方公安去做。

一行人本打算打道回府、先返回临川市局，但考虑到人员转运的风险、刘显的危重状况、以及茶城县并不算差的医疗条件，秦朗最终还是决定，已经到达茶城的几人就留在茶城，其余还在临川的队员迅速赶到茶城待命。

“敌人现在应该已经完全惊了。”

坐在县公安局的独立办公室里，秦朗一边喝着茶水、一边开口说道：

“灭口失败，他们不太可能继续冒险。”

“毕竟这不是什么穷乡僻壤，我们也已经申请了多部门联合执法，稍微脑子正常的人，都不会在这种时候来碰瓷我们。”

“接下来我们工作的重心就在这两个嫌疑人身上，过程中要警惕对方使用仪轨力量对嫌疑人进行定点清除。”

“林舒，你的平安符先多准备几张，无论是我们、还是嫌疑人都需要。”

“能搞个百八十张的最好，其他相关人员、比如参与的民警、工作人员最好也备上，以免对方通过无差别攻击制造混乱。”

“.......好。”

林舒无奈点头。

百八十张.......

你说得倒是轻松，有那么容易吗？

这玩意儿画一张就得十几二十分钟，10张就得几个小时了，还有时序性需求。

咋的，你是不打算让我睡觉了？

不说好你审讯，我们放假吗？

似乎是注意到了他的表情，秦朗歉意地笑了笑，紧接着说道：

“哎我说百八十张是夸张的，现阶段我觉得准备十来张就够了----他们要通过仪轨发起攻击也是有资源、人力和时间消耗的，不可能无限制发起攻击。”

“咱们现在拼的就是各类资源。”

“现在我们在物质资源上是充足的，就是人力上比较欠缺，所以只能靠你先扛一扛了......”

“缺人就调人呗。”

林舒还没回答，一旁的陆染倒是先开口了。

“我、靳越、霍清、还有后面到的几个人都可以先抽出来帮林舒，虽然成功率可能低一些，但按照林舒的判断，优化之后的平安符，效果应该是上升的。”

“大不了就用时间换空间嘛----哦，你一开口就让他一个人干，这说的是人话吗？”

“我的错，我的错。”

秦朗还是一如既往的积极认错的姿态。

大概是在部队呆惯了，本身又是在特种大队那种高压环境下出来的，他的思维模式已经习惯了“极限情况下孤军作战”的逻辑，映射到工作里，也多少带点“不把人当人”的习气。

当然，这并不是出于恶意。

他对自己，其实比对这些队员要狠得多。

听陆染说，刚刚加入调研一组的时候，秦朗对仪轨、民俗、宗教方面的理论那是一窍不通，他愣是熬了一个月每天只睡三四小时，才从一无所知的小白变成了半吊子专家的。

----而在这个过程中，白天他甚至还要带着队伍到处跑、到处执行侦查任务。

纯铁人来的。

略微停顿片刻，秦朗最终做出了决定。

“那就按你说的办，你们来帮林舒。”

“另外陆染，你跟付雪打个招呼，让她尽快把林舒的编制问题解决掉。”

There may be some fish that have slipped through the tea city, but that is currently outside the scope of the research team's work.

The two big fish caught on hand were enough for everyone to keep busy for a while. As for the remaining finishing work, Qin Lang directly "devolved" it to the local police.

The group originally planned to go home and return to Linchuan City Bureau first, but considering the risk of personnel transfer, Liu Xian's critical condition, and the not bad medical conditions in Chacheng County, Qin Lang finally decided that the few people who had arrived at Tea City would stay in Tea City, and the rest of the team members who were still in Linchuan quickly rushed to Tea City to stand by.

"The enemy should be completely shocked by now."

Sitting in the independent office of the County Public Security Bureau, Qin Lang drank tea and said:

"If silence fails, they are unlikely to continue taking risks."

"After all, this is not a remote area. We have also applied for joint law enforcement by multiple departments. No one in their right mind would touch us at this time."

"Next, the focus of our work will be on these two suspects. During the process, we must be alert to the other party's use of ritual power to eliminate the suspects at targeted locations."

"Lin Shu, prepare a few more peace charms for you. Both we and the suspect will need them."

“It’s best to have 180 or so copies, and it’s best for other relevant personnel, such as participating police officers and staff, to prevent the other party from creating chaos through indiscriminate attacks.”

"...Okay."

Lin Shu nodded helplessly.

One hundred and eighty pictures......

You said it was easy. Is it that easy?

It takes ten or twenty minutes to draw one picture of this thing, and several hours to draw 10 pictures. There are also timing requirements.

What, are you not going to let me sleep?

If you don't agree to interrogate us, will we have a holiday?

Seemingly noticing his expression, Qin Lang smiled apologetically and then said:

"Hey, I said one hundred and eighty is an exaggeration. At this stage, I think preparing a dozen or so is enough - if they want to launch an attack through rituals, it will also consume resources, manpower and time. It is impossible to launch an unlimited attack."

"What we are fighting for now is all kinds of resources."

"Now we have sufficient material resources, but we are relatively short of manpower, so we can only rely on you to carry it first..."

"If we need people, we'll transfer them."

Before Lin Shu could answer, Lu Ran spoke first.

"Me, Jin Yue, Huo Qing, and the few people who arrive later can all step aside to help Lin Shu. Although the success rate may be lower, according to Lin Shu's judgment, the effect of the optimized Peace Talisman should be improved."

"The worst case scenario is to trade time for space - oh, you let him do it alone as soon as you opened your mouth. Is this a human thing to say?"

"My bad, my bad."

Qin Lang still actively admitted his mistakes as always.

Probably because he was used to being in the army, and he came out of the high-pressure environment of the special forces brigade. His thinking mode has been accustomed to the logic of "fighting alone under extreme circumstances", and when mapped to work, he also has a habit of "not treating people as human beings".

Of course, this is not done out of malice.

He is actually much crueler to himself than to these team members.

According to Lu Ran, when he first joined the research team, Qin Lang knew nothing about rituals, folk customs, and religious theories. It took him a month to sleep only three or four hours a day before he changed from a clueless novice to a semi-expert.

----In the process, he even had to lead the team around during the day and perform reconnaissance missions everywhere.

From a pure iron man.

After a slight pause, Qin Lang finally made a decision.

"Then I'll do as you say, come and help Lin Shu."

"Also, Lu Ran, please say hello to Fu Xue and ask her to solve Lin Shu's staffing problem as soon as possible."
